findings.finding: The corridor limits amendment and non-derogability limits emergency, and every corridor member is non-derogable while the converse does not hold. Nothing checks the converse.
Every three-place record completion carries a distinctness constraint and an independent review authority; the challenge-reader skeleton is a later convention two families predate.
Every family with a challenge reader carries an independent alternate, so declining to read confers no veto.
No rule proves a reader received anything, acted, or completed a remedy. Every duty is a leaf.
findings.consequence: No Book 1 claim of receipt, action or completed remedy may take an established posture; operational assurance is neither built nor available.

findings.finding: A reviewed defect against an emergency declaration withdraws the requisition built on it, and the duty to inventory, return or compensate the requisitioned property goes with it, because that duty derived from the lawful measure. Restitution then depends on the independent judicial remedy the finding attests remains open, which nothing here derives.
findings.consequence: Restitution after a withdrawn requisition depends on the judicial remedy the finding attests remains open; whether to derive it here is a ruling, and until then no restitution claim is made.

findings.finding: Accessible format and language on request, proactive design, adjustment without a fee, and no meaning carried only by one sense — as conditions on a supplied record.
Script 15 checks artifact properties only. Human screen-reader validation was withdrawn and no accessibility-for-users claim follows.
findings.consequence: Gate C may claim mechanical accessibility of the artifact only; no accessibility-for-users or reader claim follows from a green check.

findings.finding: Care derives from a matching receipt and an authorised independent witness, never from a provider's own word.
No aggregate health measure exists and none may become an individual label.

The family, dependency, reproduction and care baseline landed 106 person-held barriers before it had an ordinary-operation interface; the roles, support, participation, continuity, bodily care, treatment order and own-record access that they presupposed landed afterwards, in their own block beside them.
`cares` is the posture of two passages in the whole book.
findings.consequence: No balance claim may rest on posture coverage; raising it needs another interface rather than another passage, which is how it went from one to two.

findings.finding: Recognition is arity one, minted by three doors, read by nothing and never joined with itself.
Contribution, wealth and expected productivity are refused as scarcity priority keys, each by name.
Accessible notice, interpretation, assistance, hearing, reasons, challenge and remedy are conditions on a supplied record; money and status cannot be the price of entry.
No finding proves a hearing occurred or that compensation arrived.
findings.consequence: No hearing, compensation or remedy arrival may be claimed; the justice contract states the same boundary.

findings.finding: Each coercive instrument carries a refusal pin against every floor predicate; the firewall reaches the confinement conclusion only.
The design has no rule reading a building back into a condition, service or remedy, so a facility name is never evidence of compliance.

An accusation nobody signed still takes two protections on its own — the whistleblower shield for that exposure, and recognition — because both withdraw by absence. The severity route was repaired on 2026-09-16 to read the Court's judgment and cited case, which cost nothing since every person severity can reach already had them. The harm relations still name no writer.
findings.consequence: The two remaining routes withdraw by absence and gating them would change the shield's ruled default; no claim that an accusation has an author is made anywhere.

findings.finding: A concentration finding is structural and actor-side; it adjudicates no truth, no editorial choice, and classifies no audience.
Knowledge and culture was carried by a stated boundary alone until chapter 14 gained a passage in which a reviewed restriction is found defective and stops.
Membership findings produce no standing, punishment, political weight or personal score, and free exit survives.
Foreign recognition, cooperation and readmission are named external assumptions.
findings.consequence: Recognition, cooperation and readmission are named external assumptions and may not be asserted as established in any Book 1 claim.

findings.finding: Force abroad needs prior authorisation naming objective, basis, scope, geography, means and reporting, and an immediate response ends absent ratification.

Defence was carried by a stated boundary alone until chapter 9 gained a passage in which a defence structure is found to have delegated public coercion to a private actor, and the authorisation for force abroad stops with it.
Budget choice, price exclusion, delay, withholding, monopoly, provider failure and refusal to procure are failures and not shortages, each named.
Nothing counts stock, forecasts supply or proves procurement.
findings.consequence: No supply, stock, procurement or delivery claim may take an established posture; quantitative models and operational assurance are unbuilt.

findings.finding: Commons axes are non-substitutable: no sustainability score can hide one failed condition.

Ecology and non-human animals were carried by stated boundaries alone until chapter 8 gained a reviewed record defect that withdraws only the exact affected reliance, and the animal remedy orders that follow an adjudicated harm.
Automated output is support: explanation, contest before effect, and human and independent review by somebody who is not the holder. A sole automated consequential decision is refused.
No rule reads a computed value, and the temporary-assessment exclusion keeps risk, threat, loyalty and dangerousness products out of the consequential record.
No enacted line carries a numeric literal and no relation aggregates, scores or ranks.
The counted-claims rule is guarded on its digit half only; the spelled-out half is prose review, measured at 60 legitimate uses.
findings.consequence: The counted-claims rule may be cited as guarded on its digit half only; the spelled-out half is prose review and must not be described as checked.
